features.title: workspace-init
features.summary: porta de entrada; cria .dadaia/, .venv, hooks e estrutura idempotente.

features.title: context-management
features.summary: multi-context lifecycle ALIVE/DEAD (sem global primary); session binding via eval $(dadaia context bind --mode) exporta DADAIA_SESSION_ID; três camadas de locking (workspace fcntl / per-context fcntl / per-release Lock 3 JSON com heartbeat TTL 300 s); dadaia migrate [--dry-run|--yes] (v1→v2); scaffold canonical tree v2; CLIs dadaia release new, dadaia backlog new, dadaia bug new, dadaia memory product add, dadaia migrate tree-v2.

features.title: agent-orchestration
features.summary: DAG runner que dispatcha agentes especialistas (cli/claude/codex/opencode) com parallel_groups + gates. Two-tier PM router: Tier-1 — 7 engine-backed workflows (spec-refinement, cross-cutting-feature, onboarding-new-repo, hotfix-release, game-dev-cycle, audit-cycle, code-review-fan-out) invocados via dadaia orchestrate run; Tier-2 — 13 PM Playbooks compostos inline na skill project-orchestration (file-iff-X rule determina o tier). Operador fornece somente demanda em linguagem natural; PM deriva tier, reserva task_ids, emite intake report. Topologia de 20 agentes em 3 tiers (2 orquestradores PM/auditor; curator PE; 17 leaf specialists). Model default claude-sonnet-4-6 nos 20; researcher em Haiku 4.5; escalação a Opus via DADAIA_MODEL_OVERRIDE=opus per-dispatch (ADR-X4). Emission contract sidecar-first handoff-v1.1 (ADR-X5); HTML apenas sob solicitação explícita ou next_handoff.agent == "human". Dispatch-to-researcher canônico em phases evidence-heavy (ADR-X6); frontend-design plugin restrito a frontend-engineer + design-specialist via rule plugin-scope.md (ADR-X7). Path-scope gate enforça paths.write_allowlist de cada agente em runtime. Consistência router↔artefatos garantida por invariante D-OC-1 (bidirectional) no dadaia specs doctor. Domínios cobertos: data engineering, business intelligence, AI-entity authoring.

features.title: workspace-doctor
features.summary: diagnóstico + repair de invariantes do workspace state com --fix opcional.

features.title: specs-doctor
features.summary: 19 checks estruturais SDD: 12 SPEC-DOC (memory HTML atômico, ACTIVE.md, CLOSURE evidence triples, broken images, Mermaid script, D-OC-1 bidirectional) + 7 TREE-1..7 (canonical tree v2 shape: foundation depreciada, root SPEC.md depreciado, product/index.html, backlog/bugs/releases dirs, AGENTS.md, release artifacts, bug frontmatter). --fix auto-repara TREE-3/4; migration guard para TREE-1/2.

features.title: sdd-gate-v3
features.summary: hook PreToolUse (RULE A/B/D/E/C) + PostToolUse sdd-post-gate.sh (heartbeat); RULE E valida DADAIA_SESSION_ID, mode-based path-policy matrix, ownership do Lock 3; IMPLEMENTATION resolve release do lock file (não do ACTIVE.md); R-9 bloqueia SPEC writes quando impl lock HELD.

features.title: sdd-hotfix-track
features.summary: SemVer vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH em specs/releases/ com PATCH≥1 reservado para hotfix release (fluxo condensado, origem via ## Hotfixes pendentes do backlog).

features.title: agent-sdd-alignment
features.summary: agentes, skills, workflows e templates SDD release-aware (specs/releases/<active>/ como primary; features/<feat>/ apenas Legacy compat) + dadaia specs init + doctor SPEC-DOC-003/012 + CI specs-doctor.

features.title: panel
features.summary: superfície de controle local em http://127.0.0.1:4999/ via dadaia panel; 7 tabs (Projects / Agents / Workflows / Sessions / Reports / Academy / Servers) com agent cards brand-identity (mint/sage/warm palette, WCAG AA badges), 12 workflow cards + DAG SVG server-rendered, tabela Sessions 8 colunas com per-cell min-width (CSS class selectors, floor 792px) + overflow-x:auto + Codex placeholder '—' em PROJECT, theme switcher 3 paletas, per-tab runtime toggle Claude/Codex, memory HTML via two-route proxy com memory.css brand-identity, Bearer token + CSP/nosniff; loopback bypass (panel-ux-fix-v1): GET /api/* retorna 200 sem token quando bind=127.0.0.1 (loopback_bypass=True em make_handler_class()).

features.title: agent-monitoring
features.summary: telemetria local stdlib-only consumindo Claude Code jsonl + Codex sqlite; alimenta abas Agents e Workflows do panel; allowlist gate hardcoded preserva privacidade por construção.

features.title: agent-comms
features.summary: contrato handoff-v1.1 que materializa o referente schema_ref: handoff-schema-v1; schema JSON Draft 2020-12 + CLI dadaia reports validate/lint/next stdlib-only + skill dadaia-handoff-emitter declarada e invocada pelos 21 agentes da topologia (adoção completa).

features.title: multi-platform-parity
features.summary: Pilar 3 entre Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode: Codex [agents.<name>] blocks + [skills] table em .codex/config.toml; doctor emite [not-applicable] cyan para Codex workflows; cleanup unconditional + atomic writes via _atomic_write_text.

features.title: academy
features.summary: sistema de cursos copy-from-template para onboarding de contribuidores e agentes.

features.title: workspace-portability
features.summary: export/import do workspace inteiro como tar.gz para backup ou migração entre máquinas.

features.title: repos-catalog
features.summary: lookup do repos.xlsx para discovery rápida de repos conhecidos com slug + URL.

features.title: server-registry
features.summary: registry interno de portas (3000-3999) com TTL+PID para evitar conflito entre dev servers de agentes paralelos.

features.title: brand-identity
features.summary: paleta canônica de 5 cores e tokens CSS do panel (release dadaia-workspace-brand-identity-v1).
